root.label: Grifols pauses plasma collection at 17 Canadian clinics

events.label: Grifols pauses plasma collection at 17 Canadian clinics

slots.name: clinic count
slots.sentence: The deaths, last October and in January, brought the scrutiny of Canada’s health regulator, politicians and the public toward Grifols, a Spanish company that operates Canada’s only for-profit plasma collection business at 17 clinics.

slots.name: weekly donor payment
slots.sentence: Some people rely on the extra money they make from donating plasma , which can be around 100 Canadian dollars per week, about $72.

slots.name: annual donor earnings
slots.sentence: Grifols advertises that donors can earn up to 6,000 Canadian dollars, or about $4,400, each year.

slots.name: collection status
slots.sentence: “In light of the unfounded attention that has been focused on compensated plasma collection, Grifols has proactively and voluntarily decided to pause plasma collection activities,” the company said in an emailed statement.
